{{Top|leg}}
'''Superfreighter''' was a term for a particularly massive [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] utilized superfreighters during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The superfreighters traveled to an occupied [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]] during the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the war, during which time they were escorted by Imperial [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]].
